body.condition: Uniformly over \((k,s)\in K\times S\) and every \(u\) in the compact displacement window containing \(h_s\sqrt{r_{ks}}\) for \(h\in H\), \(N_{nks}^{-3/2}K_{nks}(u/\sqrt{N_{nks}})\to\lambda_{ks}u\), with \(0<\inf_{k,s}\lambda_{ks}\le\sup_{k,s}\lambda_{ks}<\infty\).

novel.justification: For each stage--stratum block, take a distribution on a bounded interval with continuously differentiable density \(f_{ks}\) satisfying \(0<\underline f\le f_{ks}\le\overline f<\infty\), and set \(B_{nksi}=F_{ks}^{-1}((i-1/2)/N_{nks})\). A uniform Riemann-sum calculation over every fixed compact displacement window gives \(N_{nks}^{-3/2}K_{nks}(u/\sqrt{N_{nks}})\to u\int f_{ks}(x)^2\,dx\). Thus the condition is realized by explicit bounded continuous-baseline quantile arrays, with \(\lambda_{ks}=\int f_{ks}^2\), and does not encode any holdout or weight conclusion.
